description: This Java class defines a custom FreeMarker template transform for injecting CSRF tokens into Ajax calls. It implements the TemplateTransformModel interface and is used within the OFBiz framework to generate CSRF tokens dynamically for HTTP requests.

classes.name: CsrfTokenAjaxTransform
classes.description: A FreeMarker transform class for injecting CSRF tokens in Ajax responses within the OFBiz framework.

methods.name: getWriter
methods.description: Returns a Writer that injects CSRF token into the output for Ajax calls by accessing the current environment's request object.
